description_en: Moves a resource to another resource group
description_zh: 修改云资源所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun slb move-resource-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id lb-uf6ghek7ds2btzt650000 --resource-type loadbalancer --new-resource-group-id rg-aek2rpsek5h0000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MoveResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource for which you want to modify the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改资源组的目标资源的ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

loadbalancer: a CLB instance

certificate: a certificate

acl: an access control list (ACL)
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型定义，取值：

loadbalancer：传统型负载均衡实例。

certificate：证书。

acl：访问控制
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the resource
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The AccessKey ID provided to you by Alibaba Cloud for accessing the service
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云颁发给用户的访问服务所用的密钥ID
parameters.name: access_key_id
